Belarus U21 vs Wales U21: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a qualifying match for the 2027 UEFA European Under-21 Championship, where the Belarus U21 national team hosts Wales U21 at their nominal home ground in Armenia. This is a meeting of two group underdogs who have almost lost their chances of qualifying for the Euros and will be playing for pride.

Kick-off: November 14, 2025, 14:00 UTC (17:00 MSK) Stadium: Armavir City Stadium, Armavir, Armenia Competition: Euro 2027 U-21 Qualifying

Belarus U21 vs Wales U21: Match Preview

Both teams have had a disastrous qualifying campaign, sitting at the bottom of Group I. Both Belarus and Wales have only 6 points after 7 matches played. The Belarusians have lost their last three matches in a row, including a heavy 5-0 defeat to Portugal. Wales, in contrast, secured a 2-1 victory over Lithuania in the last round, ending their losing streak. The head-to-head history is balanced: in three matches, each team has won once, and one game ended in a draw. The first-round match ended in a 2-1 victory for Wales.

Team Form and Analysis

Belarus U21

The 'White Wings' are in a deep crisis. Sergey Yasinsky's team is showing extremely poor attacking play, having scored only 4 goals in 7 matches, the worst record in the group. Three consecutive defeats are putting immense pressure on the team. In a match against an opponent of equal strength, the Belarusians will try to break their dreadful streak.

Wales U21

The 'Dragons' are in a better psychological state after their victory over Lithuania. Mat Jones's side is also not known for high-scoring games, but their defense has been slightly more reliable than their opponent's. The Welsh will be aiming for a second consecutive victory to end the qualifying campaign on a high note. A player to watch in the Wales squad is Liverpool forward Lewis Koumas.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Belarus U21 (5-4-1): Skopets; Borisevich, Moskalenchik, Kasarab, Yakushevich, Makarenko; Pechura, Dushevskiy, Kravtsov, Martynov; Karpitskiy.
  • Wales U21 (4-3-3): Searle-Cook; Lawlor, Hammond, Evans, Govek; Sheehan, Cooper, Cullen; Koumas, Harris, Goddall.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A match between two evenly matched underdogs is extremely difficult to predict. Belarus is playing on a nominally home field, but Wales is in better current form.

  • Main Prediction: Wales to Win or Draw (X2). Given the terrible form of the Belarus team and the Welsh victory in the first round, a bet on the visitors at least avoiding defeat looks reliable.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. This is a meeting of the two worst attacks in the group. 8 of the last 10 matches involving the Belarus team have been low-scoring. A tight contest with a minimal number of goals is expected.

Argentina U17 vs Mexico U17: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a Latin American super derby in the Round of 32 of the FIFA U-17 World Cup, featuring two of the most decorated national teams from their respective confederations - Argentina and Mexico. This is a classic rivalry, full of history and intensity, that promises to be one of the highlights of the knockout stage.

Kick-off: November 14, 2025, 14:45 UTC (17:45 MSK) Stadium: Aspire Zone - Pitch 2, Doha Competition: FIFA U-17 World Cup, Round of 32

Argentina U17 vs Mexico U17: Match Preview

The teams have taken different paths to the knockout stage. Argentina, under coach Diego Placente, flawlessly navigated the group stage with three wins from three matches, demonstrating excellent form. Mexico, on the other hand, qualified for the Round of 32 dramatically and almost miraculously, finishing as one of the best third-placed teams after one win and two losses. Now, 'El Tri' faces its most historic and difficult rival. The history of encounters between these teams at the U-17 World Cup includes three matches, with the advantage on the side of the Mexicans (two wins to one).

Team Form and Analysis

Argentina U17

The 'Albiceleste' have brought another generation of super talents to the tournament, showcasing the typical Argentine style of technical, attacking, and combination-based football. The team is at the peak of its form, having secured a series of victories and demonstrated high goal-scoring ability in the group stage. The Argentines will aim to dominate from the first minutes and prove their status as one of the main tournament favorites.

Mexico U17

The Mexicans, despite a less-than-ideal group stage, have always been known for their fighting spirit, especially in knockout matches. 'El Tri' are two-time world champions at this age level and should never be written off. The team will rely on an organized defense and fast counter-attacks. Despite being the underdog in this pairing, the Mexicans are capable of pulling off an upset.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Argentina U17 (4-2-3-1): Díaz; Gorosito, Palacios, Giménez, Ontivero; Albarracín, Gutiérrez; Echeverri, Subiabre, López; Ruberto.
  • Mexico U17 (4-4-2): Rodriguez; Chavarria, Ojeda, Contreras, D'Gomez; Cibrian, Torres, Lopez, Ortega; Carrillo, de Nigris Gonzalez.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite Mexico's history and status, the Argentine team looks significantly more powerful and consistent in this tournament. Their current form makes them the clear favorites.

  • Main Prediction: Argentina to Win. The 'Albiceleste' are in excellent form and should advance to the quarter-finals by defeating an inconsistent, albeit historic, rival.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Knockout matches are often cautious, but clashes between these two teams have historically been high-scoring. Argentina's attacking potential and Mexico's need to take risks could lead to an open game.

Uzbekistan vs Egypt: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a fascinating friendly match where one of Asia's strongest teams, Uzbekistan, hosts one of the giants of African football, Egypt, in Tashkent. This match will be an excellent test for both teams against a representative from another confederation.

Kick-off: November 14, 2025, 17:00 UTC (20:00 MSK) Stadium: Bunyodkor Stadium, Tashkent Competition: International Friendly

Uzbekistan vs Egypt: Match Preview

Both teams come into this match in good form. The Uzbekistan national team, under Srečko Katanec, has shown impressive progress, performing successfully in the World Cup qualifiers. The 'White Wolves' have been unbeaten for a long time, especially at home. The Egyptian national team, in turn, is also one of the leading forces on its continent and boasts a wealth of world-class stars. This will be the first-ever meeting between these national teams, which adds special interest.

Team Form and Analysis

Uzbekistan

The 'White Wolves' rely on tactical discipline, ball control, and fast attacks. Srečko Katanec's team is known for its organized play and ability to compete. At home, with the support of their fans, the Uzbek team is capable of challenging any opponent. The team's leaders are Eldor Shomurodov, Abbosbek Fayzullaev, and Jaloliddin Masharipov, who play in strong European leagues.

Egypt

The 'Pharaohs' have one of the strongest squads in Africa. The team's main star is undoubtedly Liverpool forward Mohamed Salah, who orchestrates the entire attack. Besides Salah, the Egyptian squad features many quality players from European leagues. The team will be looking to prove their class and secure a victory even in a challenging away match in Tashkent.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Uzbekistan (4-2-3-1): Yusupov; Sayfiev, Ashurmatov, Eshmuradov, Alikulov; Khamrobekov, Shukurov; Urunov, Fayzullaev, Masharipov; Shomurodov.
  • Egypt (4-3-3): El Shenawy; Hany, Hegazi, Abdelmonem, Hamdy; Ashour, Fathi, Attia; Salah, Mohamed, Trézéguet.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite its friendly status, the match promises to be tense and interesting. The Uzbekistan national team is a formidable force at home. However, the individual class of the Egyptian players, especially Mohamed Salah, makes them slight favorites.

  • Main Prediction: Egypt to Win or Draw (X2). Given the presence of world-class stars in their squad, the Egyptians should at least avoid defeat against a solid but less-skilled Uzbekistan team. A draw is also a very likely outcome in a friendly match.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Both teams to score. Uzbekistan scores regularly at home, and the attacking power of Egypt, led by Salah, is beyond doubt. An exchange of goals in such a game looks highly likely.

Germany U21 vs Malta U21: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a qualifying match for the 2027 UEFA European Under-21 Championship, where one of the main tournament favorites, the Germany U21 national team, hosts one of the underdogs, Malta U21. This is a classic David vs. Goliath encounter.

Kick-off: November 14, 2025, 17:00 UTC (20:00 MSK) Stadium: Benteler-Arena, Paderborn Competition: Euro 2027 U-21 Qualifying

Germany U21 vs Malta U21: Match Preview

The teams approach this match from opposite ends of the group table. The German national team is confidently leading the group, having won all their previous matches and demonstrating phenomenal goal-scoring form. The Malta national team, on the other hand, is one of the underdogs, having failed to earn a single point and conceding the most goals in the group. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of the Germans, who have won all four previous encounters with a combined score of 25-1, including a 7-0 thrashing in the first-round match.

Team Form and Analysis

Germany U21

The 'Bundes-team' U21 is packed with talent from Germany's top clubs, many of whom are already knocking on the door of the senior national team. The team focuses on total ball control, high pressing, and combination play. In attack, the young Bayern Munich star Youssoufa Moukoko, who is the team's top scorer, is shining. The Germans will be aiming for another comprehensive victory and will look to entertain their fans with a high-scoring game.

Malta U21

For the Maltese national team, matches against such giants are, first and foremost, an invaluable experience. The team will focus on a deep and layered defense, trying to avoid a heavy defeat. Any goal scored against the German national team will be a great success for the islanders.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Germany U21 (4-3-3): Urbig; Kleine-Bekel, Gechter, Arrey-Mbi, Rothe; Martel, Röhl, Knauff; Adeyemi, Moukoko, Gruda.
  • Malta U21 (5-4-1): Vella; Micallef, Borg, Bongiovi, Vassallo, Vella; Ellul, Engerer, Vella, Zammit; Tuma.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Germany is the absolute and undisputed favorite for this contest. The difference in class between the teams is colossal. The only question is how many goals the German national team will score.

  • Main Prediction: Germany to Win with a (-4.5) Handicap. The 'Bundes-team' will leave no stone unturned at home against one of the weakest participants in the qualifiers.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Germany's Individual Total Over 5 Goals. The attacking power of the Germans and the level of their opponent suggest a very high number of goals.

Finland vs Malta: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a European qualifier for the 2026 World Cup, where the Finland national team hosts Malta at the Helsinki Olympic Stadium. For the hosts, this is a chance to bounce back from recent setbacks and please their fans, while for the visitors, this is a match for pride.

Kick-off: November 14, 2025, 17:00 UTC (20:00 MSK) Stadium: Helsinki Olympic Stadium, Helsinki Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying (Europe)

Finland vs Malta: Match Preview

The teams approach this match from the lower part of the group table. Finland, sitting in third place, has virtually lost all chances of qualifying for the World Cup after a heavy 4-0 defeat to the Netherlands in the last round. Malta is at the bottom of the table, having failed to win any of their six matches and earning only two points. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of the Eagle-owls: Finland has won the last six encounters and is unbeaten against Malta in eight matches. The first-round match ended in a minimal 1-0 victory for the Finns.

Team Form and Analysis

Finland

The 'Eagle-owls' will be highly motivated to end their qualifying campaign on a high note in front of their home fans. Despite recent setbacks, the team has a quality squad, featuring forwards Benjamin Källman and Joel Pohjanpalo. At home, the Finns traditionally play boldly and will aim to dominate from the first minutes.

Malta

The 'Knights of St. John' have had a disastrous qualifying campaign, scoring only one goal and conceding sixteen. The team is winless in their last seven competitive matches. It will be extremely difficult for the Maltese to hope for a positive result in an away match against a historically difficult opponent. The team is likely to adopt a deep defensive strategy.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Finland (4-3-3): Joronen; Ståhl, Tenho, Koski, Alho; Lod, Peltola, Kairinen; Antman, Källman, Pohjanpalo.
  • Malta (5-4-1): Bonello; Mbong, Shaw, Pepe, Borg, Camenzuli; Teuma, Guillaumier, Muscat, Jones; Satariano.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Finland is the absolute favorite for this contest. The difference in class, the home-field advantage, and their total dominance in head-to-head meetings make a victory for the hosts almost a foregone conclusion.

  • Main Prediction: Finland to Win with a (-1.5) Handicap. Despite the lack of tournament motivation, the Finns should comfortably defeat one of the main underdogs of European qualification at home.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Although both teams are not known for high-scoring games, all three of their recent head-to-head meetings have gone over 2.5 goals, with an average of 3.67 goals per game.

Slovakia vs Northern Ireland: Match Preview

Both teams come into this match needing to pick up points. Slovakia, under Francesco Calzona, successfully qualified for Euro 2024 and is looking to build on that success in the World Cup qualifiers. Northern Ireland, in turn, is undergoing a generational change but remains a dangerous and resilient opponent, especially in home matches. Slovakia

The 'Falcons' rely on a solid defense and the experience of their leaders, who play in Europe's top leagues. At home, with the support of their fans, the Slovak national team plays with particular confidence. The team's main stars are PSG defender Milan Škriniar and Napoli midfielder Stanislav Lobotka. In attack, Róbert Boženík stands out.

Northern Ireland

The 'Green and White Army' is known for its British style, fighting spirit, and skill from set pieces. Despite the lack of world-class stars, the team is strong in its organization and commitment. Against the technical Slovaks, the Northern Irish will try to impose a physical battle and use their advantage in physical strength.

The Luxembourg national team, which has made incredible progress in recent years and is no longer a 'minnow,' will be highly motivated to challenge their illustrious neighbor in front of their home fans. Poland vs Netherlands: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of one of the key European qualifiers for the 2026 World Cup, where the Poland national team hosts the Netherlands at the Stadion Narodowy in Warsaw. This is a direct battle for the top spot in Group G, where a victory for the visitors would secure their ticket to the World Cup ahead of schedule.

Kick-off: November 14, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK) Stadium: Stadion Narodowy, Warsaw Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying (Europe)

Poland vs Netherlands: Match Preview

The teams approach this match as the group leaders. The Netherlands tops the table, three points ahead of Poland. The 'Oranje' are in excellent form, having won three consecutive matches since their 1-1 draw with the Poles in the first leg. The Polish national team, in turn, has also shown consistent results, but a surprise defeat to Finland has complicated their fight for first place. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of the Dutch: the Netherlands are unbeaten against Poland in 14 matches over 46 years and have won their last five away encounters.

Team Form and Analysis

Poland

The 'White Eagles' will be highly motivated to get revenge and keep their chances for the top spot alive. At home, with the support of their fans, the Poles are capable of challenging any opponent. The team relies on a solid defense and fast counter-attacks, where the legendary striker Robert Lewandowski plays a key role. Poland has scored in all of their last 15 matches, which speaks to their attacking potential.

Netherlands

Ronald Koeman's side is playing some of the most prolific football in the qualifiers, having scored 22 goals. The 'Oranje' attack, led by Memphis Depay with 7 goals, poses a huge threat. The Netherlands are on a 10-match unbeaten run and will be looking to secure their spot at the World Cup early to avoid a nervy finish in the final round.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Poland (3-5-2): Grabara; Kędziora, Ziółkowski, Kiwior; Cash, Kozłowski, Zieliński, Skóraś, Szymański; Kamiński, Lewandowski.
  • Netherlands (3-4-3): Verbruggen; Dumfries, Timber, van Dijk, van de Ven; Gravenberch, de Jong, Reijnders; Malen, Depay, Gakpo.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite Poland's home-field advantage, the Netherlands national team is the favorite for this match. Their current form, phenomenal goal-scoring record, and head-to-head statistics make the 'Oranje's' chances of winning significantly higher.

  • Main Prediction: Netherlands to Win. Ronald Koeman's team will be aiming to secure their World Cup qualification early and will likely achieve a victory against a strong but historically favorable opponent.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. This is a meeting of two attacking teams. The Netherlands have scored 11 goals in their last three qualifiers, and Poland has been scoring for 15 consecutive games. A high-scoring game is expected.
